title: Heady Chinese Tofu Fried-Rice
description: Sour, gooey midnight-craving fried rice featuring 00-flour coated tofu and nigiri-shaped portions, satvik-friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Pat tofu dry with paper towels and cut into 1 cm cubes.
Whisk 00 flour with 2 tbsp water to form a thin batter.
Toss tofu cubes in batter until evenly coated and let excess drip off.
Heat sesame oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and fry tofu until golden and crisp, about 3-4 minutes; drain on paper towel.
Whisk rice vinegar, tamarind paste, sugar, soy sauce, and a pinch of salt until sugar dissolves in a small bowl.
Heat the same skillet, add cooked rice, and stir-fry for 2 minutes to warm through.
Add fried tofu to the skillet, pour the sauce over, and toss gently to coat all grains and cubes.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and sliced scallion, then stir until fragrant and evenly mixed.
Divide the mixture into 6-8 small nigiri-sized portions, shape each into a firm round, and serve immediately.
